learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition by students of theoretical and practical knowledge regarding thermodynamic phenomena as well as the functioning of thermal and refrigeration equipment.
Acquisition of information, from an energetic point of view, applied to thermal and refrigeration installations.
Knowledge of how relationships between thermal quantities are established.
Knowledge of how thermal and refrigeration installations operate – characteristic curves, compressors, air conditioning installations, boilers, heat exchangers.
Knowledge of the terminology used in Thermal and Refrigeration Installations.
Ability to use, explain and interpret the specific concepts of the Thermal and Refrigeration Installations discipline.
Use of principles and tools for describing thermal systems and processes.
Ability to practically apply the notions presented during lectures.
Ability to evaluate and interpret experimental results.

syllabus_topics: Definitions, classifications (Energy sources, Fluids as energy carriers, Energy balance)

Main parameters and characteristic curves of power machines (Main parameters of engine machines, Main parameters of generator machines, Characteristic curves of machines, Nominal values of main parameters)
Fluid flow (Ideal fluid flow, Real fluid flow, Local and longitudinal pressure losses, Pipe diameter selection)
Volumetric compressors (Piston compressors, Rotary piston compressors)
Turbogenerators (Energy transformations in turbomachines, Centrifugal fans, Axial fans, Turbocompressors)
Boilers (Water vapor diagram, Thermal power plant scheme, Clausius-Rankine cycle)
Heat exchangers (Constructive types, Main sizing parameters)
Refrigeration machines (Refrigerants, Calculation of refrigeration needs, Mechanical vapor compression machine)
Stationary air conditioning systems (Thermal comfort, Split type air conditioning system, Heat pump)
Automotive air conditioning systems (Calculation of cooling requirements for a vehicle, Cooling system, Ventilation system)
Explanation and presentation of graphic materials, relationships, examples with the help of a video projector
Thermal calculation of the cooling cycle
teaching_methods: Lectures (exposure with multimedia, explanation, and demonstration)
Practical applications (explanation and presentation of graphic materials, relationships, examples with video projector)

assessment_methods.method: Mixed method (formative and summative) for applied activities

assessment_rules: The passing criterion consists of obtaining a final grade of at least 5. To meet this criterion, both the exam grade and the laboratory and project grades must be at least 5.
